title: 'Bengaluru can be a lonely city': Entrepreneur shares 7 things that stood out after moving from Mumbai
summary: Kalpesh Bhalekar has sparked a conversation on X after sharing his first impressions of Bengaluru after moving from Mumbai. From the city's thriving startup culture and pleasant weather to its infamous traffic and social life.
